dashboard.name: Chart Reference
dashboard.description: Exhaustive customization reference — one page per chart type. Each tile demonstrates ONE chartOption value so you can see exactly what every setting does.

chartOptions.content:
## Bar chart — every option exhaustively demonstrated

Each tile shows the same dataset with **one setting changed**. The tile title tells you what is different from default.

Demonstrates: orientation, stackMode (normal/stacked/percent), barWidth, barGap, showValues, showLegend, axes labels, showGridLines, axisLabelRotation, referenceLines, color palette, colorblind mode, rule-based styling.

*Refresh the page to reset all parameters.*
